column28:
*Feature:* FEAT-08  Customer Satisfaction Feedback
*Epic:* EPIC-04  Usage Analytics Capture
*Requirement:* FR-09
*Business Objective:* BO-04

*Requirement:* The system captures lightweight satisfaction feedback at natural completion points, starting with a single-tap rating after a harvest is logged.

*Scope:* MVP covers the post-harvest satisfaction prompt only. A Plant Library satisfaction variant is deferred.

*Dependency:* The prompt depends on a harvest being successfully logged through the Harvest Tracker flow.

*Draft Acceptance Criteria  Pending Product Owner Persona Refinement*

*AC1 — Post-harvest prompt*
Given a harvest has been successfully logged, when the harvest action reaches its completion point, then a satisfaction prompt is presented to the user.

*AC2 — Single-tap rating*
Given the satisfaction prompt is displayed after a completed harvest, when the user selects a satisfaction rating with a single tap, then the rating is captured successfully.

*AC3 — Satisfaction signal capture*
Given a satisfaction rating has been submitted after a completed harvest, when the submission completes, then the satisfaction signal is recorded alongside the usage-event flow for the post-harvest action.
